title: Vintage Gold Green Pear & Pearl Botanical Bracelet
storyHtml:
A little sprig of gold leaves cradling a green pear crystal and a single pearl — like a pressed flower kept forever. Romantic and a touch old-world.

Jewelry that marks your every becoming.
detailsBullets: Pear-cut 5A green zircon, shell pearl & clear zircon
